title: Before merging partial responses, make sure they belong to the same representation
summary: Byte ranges can be combined only if they belong to the same representation. A strong validator can help determine whether separately obtained parts do.
applies: Offline HTTP transactions and partial response logging
detail: Even if two 206s of the same URL happen to be connected end to end, they cannot be regarded as the same object if their strong ETags are different.
boundary: A weak ETag only expresses weak equivalence and cannot be used to prove that the segmented bytes are identical.
relevance: When rebuilding attachments from multiple requests, avoid piecing together different versions of the pieces.
